questions.question: What festival did Israel keep in the wilderness in this chapter?
How did Israel know when to travel and when to camp?
options: By the cloud over the tabernacle
By the word of Moses each morning
By the turning of the seasons
By the position of the stars
questions.answer: By the cloud over the tabernacle

questions.question: When the cloud lifted, Israel set out; when it settled, they camped.
Whenever the _____ was taken up from over the tent, the Israelites journeyed.
Those unable to keep the Passover at the proper time could keep it in the second _____.
